summary.text: Jacob Schodowski is the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the party's June 6 convention.
He is an electrician and, in a Ballotpedia survey, said he is a journeyman with IBEW Local 58.

paragraphs.text: Jacob Schodowski graduated from Lutheran High Northwest and completed the Detroit Electrical Industry Training Center in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has worked in construction, warehouses and industrial workplaces for most of his adult life.
He listed his key messages as working-class control of society, opposition to war, and working-class solidarity, and said he supports guaranteed employment at a living wage.
